title: A Clinical Prognostic Model Based on Machine Learning from the Fondazione Italiana Linfomi (FIL) MCL0208 Phase III Trial.
summary: A machine-learning prognostic score derived from the phase III MCL0208 trial stratified mantle-cell-lymphoma patient outcomes and was checked in external trial cohorts.
ai_technology: Methods define trial and prognostic model; Results report score stratification and external validation in European MCL cohorts.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A machine-learning prognostic score derived from the phase III MCL0208 trial stratified mantle-cell-lymphoma patient outcomes and was checked in external trial cohorts.
evidence.unknown: The score was derived from the MCL0208 trial and checked in external trial cohorts; this is prognostic stratification evidence, not proof of treatment benefit.
